rows.title_full: AN ACT ENHANCING THE PUBLIC-PRIVATE PARTNERSHIP IN INFRASTRUCTURE DEVELOPMENT IN THE PHILIPPINES
rows.status: Recommendations submitted by the TWG on 2011-08-17

committee_action.action: Recommendations submitted by the TWG on 2011-08-17
committee_action.meethigh:
Resource persons was requested to submit their written comments till August 31, 2011 and comments from the different stakeholders were as follows:
>Philippine Contractor's Association (PCA) representative commented the need to reform the accepted ROI pegged at 12% and the need to require court judges to set deadlines in issuing writ of possession on properties involved on PPP project.
>Wallace Business Forum suggested that the government should pay twice the market value of properties in PPP projects and pre-determination of market value to eliminate the need for negotiations.
>Inclusion the timeline in project implementation and process of approval and provisions in the turn over of PPP projects to the government.
>Consensus to change the rank of the PPP Center head from Assistant Secretary to Secretary as an equal stature with the heads of various departments.
>Creation of Congressional Oversight Committee in drafting the (IRR) Implementing Rules and Regulations and inclusion of Commission on Audit (COA).
>Hon. Jeci Lapuz recommended the consolidation of the bills with amendments to the BOT Law subject to style and with provisions addressing the different concerns enumerated.
